# Calendly outage history — every incident their status page has posted

**25 Calendly incidents on record** spanning **2026-04-15** to **2026-07-23**. Status page:
[https://www.calendlystatus.com](https://www.calendlystatus.com) · platform:
`statuspage` · last polled **2026-09-11 12:29 UTC**, last observed
state **`ok`**.

Only **3** Calendly incidents carry both a vendor-posted start and resolve time — below the 20-incident floor this dataset requires before publishing a median, so none is quoted here.

This page republishes what Calendly posted on its own status page. It is rebuilt
daily by an automated poller — no login, no account, MIT-licensed data.

## What is counted, and what is not

Of 25 recorded incidents, **3** have a usable length. Excluded:
0 maintenance, 0 still open or missing a timestamp, 0 whose resolution time we inferred rather than read, 22 with a resolve time before the start time. Those exclusions are the reason the numbers here are lower than a naive
count of the status page, and they are why a median from this dataset can be
compared across vendors at all.

"Incidents on record" means incidents this poller has seen or backfilled since
**2026-09-04** — it is not a claim about Calendly's
entire operating history.
